comparison.objective: Stabilize a paint tin, pry up three rim tabs, remove the lid, and stow the tool; candidate breaks and recovers four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, repeated claw engagement, levering, lid removal, and tool stowage versus coaxial mandrel holding, hammer impacts, notch fracture, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: All three tabs raised, lid placed beside an untipped tin, lifter returned, and arms reset versus four contact-loaded fractures and four contained tangs without damage.
comparison.reason: There is shared bimanual force-tool use, but levering reusable tabs to open a lid tests a different mechanism and terminal state from impact fracture and fragment recovery.
